
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>dejaquetepique — surrealich</title>
<meta name="description" content="surrealich — sensorial receptor and transmitter. anti-disciplinary artist. experimental researcher. Madrid · Berlin · East Africa · Kilifi.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@300;400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --deep:#1A1B5E;--deeper:#0D0E3A;--deepest:#07081F;
  --indigo:#2D2E7A;--teal:#1B8A8A;--teal-light:#4EC4C4;
  --orange:#E8722A;--cream:#E8E4F0;
  --ghost:rgba(232,228,240,.55);--ghost-dim:rgba(232,228,240,.2);
  --mono:'DM Mono',monospace;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:300;background:var(--deepest);color:var(--cream);overflow-x:hidden;cursor:crosshair}
body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 60% at 20% 30%,rgba(30,140,140,.07) 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 100% at 80% 70%,rgba(45,46,122,.12) 0%,transparent 60%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;animation:caustic 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes caustic{0%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1) translate(0,0)}50%{opacity:.9;transform:scale(1.04) translate(-1%,2%)}100%{opacity:.8;transform:scale(1.02) translate(-2%,1%)}}

/* NAV BANNER */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;height:56px;overflow:hidden;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);background:rgba(7,8,31,.75);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08);display:flex;align-items:center}
.nav-banner{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;opacity:.25;filter:saturate(.8)}
.nav-banner img{flex:1;object-fit:cover;height:100%}
.nav-logo{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 1.5rem;flex-shrink:0}
.nav-logo img{height:32px;width:auto;display:block;filter:brightness(1.1)}
.nav-links{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:0 1.5rem;margin-left:auto}
.nav-links a{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;opacity:.35;transition:opacity .3s}
.nav-links a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--teal-light)}

/* PAGE 0 — STING */
#sting{min-height:100vh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-top:56px;background:var(--deepest)}
#sting img.hero-img{display:block;width:100%;height:calc(100vh - 56px);object-fit:contain;object-position:center;z-index:0;animation:heroFloat 8s ease-in-out infinite;filter:saturate(1.05)}
@keyframes heroFloat{0%{transform:translateY(0px) scale(1.01)}50%{transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.03)}100%{transform:translateY(0px) scale(1.01)}}
/* roles strip below hero */
.sting-roles-strip{padding:2.5rem 2.5rem 2rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.35rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s ease forwards .4s}
.sting-role{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:lowercase;color:rgba(232,228,240,.4)}
.sting-role.bright{color:rgba(78,196,196,.7);font-size:.65rem}
.sting-more{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(78,196,196,.2);margin-top:.4rem;font-style:italic}
.sting-poem{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(.85rem,1.5vw,1rem);font-style:italic;color:rgba(232,228,240,.25);margin-top:1rem;line-height:1.7}
/* hide old overlay elements */
.sting-content{display:none}
.sting-bottom{display:none}
.sting-name,.sting-also,.sting-questions,.sting-q,.sting-let,.sting-right{display:none}

/* SECTIONS */
.sec{padding:5rem 2rem;position:relative;z-index:1}
.sec-dark{background:var(--deeper)}
.sec-deep{background:var(--deepest)}
.sec-indigo{background:var(--indigo)}
.inner{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto}
.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.8rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);padding-bottom:1rem;margin-bottom:3rem}
.sh-n{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2rem;color:var(--teal-light);font-weight:300}
.sh-t{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:300}
.sh-s{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);margin-left:auto}

/* ESSENCE */
.essence-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr;gap:3rem;align-items:start}
.essence-photos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px}
.essence-photos .main{grid-column:1/-1}
.bio-head{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.2rem);font-weight:300;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.bio-head em{font-style:italic;color:var(--teal-light)}
.bio-p{font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ghost);margin-bottom:.9rem}
.index-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;margin:1.5rem 0 2rem}
.index-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.15);padding:4px 8px;transition:all .3s}
.index-link:hover{color:var(--teal-light);border-color:var(--teal-light)}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.8rem;margin-top:1.5rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1)}
.fact-l{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:2px}
.fact-v{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ghost);line-height:1.5}

/* NOW */
.now-intro{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1.2rem,2.5vw,1.7rem);font-style:italic;color:rgba(78,196,196,.7);margin-bottom:2rem;line-height:1.5}
.now-body{font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ghost);max-width:680px;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.now-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2rem;margin-top:2rem}
.now-card{background:rgba(45,46,122,.2);border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);padding:1.5rem}
.now-card-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:.8rem}
.now-card-body{font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ghost)}
.now-reflection{background:rgba(7,8,31,.5);border-left:2px solid rgba(78,196,196,.3);padding:1.2rem 1.5rem;margin-top:1.5rem;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:.95rem;font-style:italic;color:rgba(232,228,240,.5);line-height:1.8}

/* TECH + BTL */
.tech-block{margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:2.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08)}
.tech-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.3rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.tech-sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);margin-bottom:.8rem}
.tech-body{font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ghost)}
.skills-wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;margin-top:1rem}
.skill-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:lowercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.15);padding:3px 8px}
.btl-grid-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2rem;margin-top:2rem}
.btl-section{margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.btl-section-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.btl-section-body{font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ghost)}

/* GALLERY GRID */
.gallery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:4px;margin-top:1rem}
.gallery-grid img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;cursor:zoom-in;display:block;transition:opacity .3s}
.gallery-grid img:hover{opacity:.8}

/* SENSUOUS */
.sensuous-intro-block{background:rgba(45,46,122,.25);border-left:2px solid rgba(78,196,196,.3);padding:1.2rem 1.5rem;margin-bottom:2rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--ghost);line-height:1.8;font-size:.9rem}
.ev-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:.8rem}
.ev-card{background:rgba(45,46,122,.15);border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);padding:1.2rem;transition:all .4s}
.ev-card:hover{background:rgba(45,46,122,.3);border-color:rgba(78,196,196,.25)}
.ev-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.25);font-weight:300;line-height:1}
.ev-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1rem;color:var(--cream);font-style:italic;margin:.3rem 0}
.ev-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5)}
.ev-body{font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ghost-dim);margin-top:.5rem}

/* PROJECT CARD */
.proj-card{background:rgba(78,196,196,.03);border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08);padding:2rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.proj-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.proj-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;color:var(--cream);font-weight:300;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.proj-period{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.35);margin-bottom:.9rem}
.proj-body{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ghost)}
.proj-quote{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-style:italic;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);border-left:2px solid var(--teal);padding-left:.8rem;margin:1rem 0;line-height:1.6}
.proj-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:1rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.2);padding-bottom:2px;transition:all .3s}
.proj-link:hover{color:var(--teal-light);border-color:var(--teal-light)}

/* PRODUCTIONS */
.prod-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;margin-top:1.5rem}
.prod-item{border-left:2px solid rgba(78,196,196,.2);padding:.8rem 1.2rem;display:flex;gap:2rem;align-items:baseline}
.prod-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--cream);min-width:120px}
.prod-desc{font-size:.87rem;color:var(--ghost);line-height:1.6}

/* DJ GIGS */
.venue-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem;margin-top:1.5rem}
.venue-item{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ghost);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.05);padding-bottom:.6rem}
.venue-item strong{color:var(--cream)}

/* CONTACT */
.contact-block{max-width:500px}
.contact-poem{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-style:italic;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);margin-bottom:2rem;line-height:1.6}
.contact-item{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:baseline;padding-bottom:.8rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.06);margin-bottom:.8rem}
.contact-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);width:80px;flex-shrink:0}
.contact-val{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;transition:color .3s}
.contact-val:hover{color:var(--teal-light)}

/* LIGHTBOX */
.lb-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(7,8,31,.97);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column}
.lb-overlay.active{display:flex}
.lb-img{max-width:92vw;max-height:82vh;object-fit:contain}
.lb-caption{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.35);margin-top:.6rem}
.lb-counter{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.2);margin-top:.3rem}
.lb-close{position:fixed;top:1.5rem;right:1.5rem;font-size:2rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.4);cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;line-height:1}
.lb-prev,.lb-next{position:fixed;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:2.5rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:1rem;line-height:1}
.lb-prev{left:.5rem}.lb-next{right:.5rem}
.lb-close:hover,.lb-prev:hover,.lb-next:hover{color:var(--teal-light)}

/* UTILS */
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
.placeholder{background:rgba(78,196,196,.04);border:1px dashed rgba(78,196,196,.1);padding:2rem;text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.2)}

@media(max-width:768px){
  nav{flex-wrap:wrap;height:auto;padding:.6rem 1rem}
  .nav-links{display:none}
  #sting .sting-content{grid-template-columns:1fr;height:auto;padding-top:2rem}
  .sting-right{text-align:left}
  .essence-grid,.now-grid,.btl-grid-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .ev-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .facts{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .prod-item{flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
}

/* DJ GIGS GRID */
.gig-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:6px;margin-top:2rem}
.gig-item{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(45,46,122,.1)}
.gig-item img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .4s ease,filter .4s ease;filter:saturate(.7)}
.gig-item:hover img{transform:scale(1.04);filter:saturate(1)}
.gig-caption{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:.5rem .6rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.48rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(232,228,240,.8);background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(7,8,31,.85));opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.gig-item:hover .gig-caption{opacity:1}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <div class="nav-banner"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="ear" /><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="ear" /></div>
  <a href="#sting" class="nav-logo">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="deja que te pique" />
  </a>
  <div class="nav-links">
    <a href="#essence">Essence</a>
    <a href="#now">The Now</a>
    <a href="#tech">Technical</a>
    <a href="#btl">Born to Learn</a>
    <a href="#ngoteya">Ngoteya Wild</a>
    <a href="#sensuous">Sensuous</a>
    <a href="#museum">Museum of Consciousness</a>
    <a href="#circulus">Circulus</a>
    <a href="#spiral">SPIRAL</a>
    <a href="#field">Field Recording</a>
    <a href="#productions">Productions</a>
    <a href="#dj">DJ Gigs</a>
    <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- PAGE 0 — THE STING -->
<section id="sting">
  <img class="hero-img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="surrealich" />
  <div class="sting-roles-strip">
    <div class="sting-role bright">sensorial receptor and transmitter</div>
    <div class="sting-role bright">anti-disciplinary artist</div>
    <div class="sting-role bright">experimental researcher</div>
    <div class="sting-role">sonic explorer</div>
    <div class="sting-role">space holder</div>
    <div class="sting-role">event creator and manager</div>
    <div class="sting-role">stage manager</div>
    <div class="sting-role">NGO coordinator</div>
    <div class="sting-role">storyteller</div>
    <div class="sting-role">sound artist</div>
    <div class="sting-role">sound technician</div>
    <div class="sting-role">field recordist</div>
    <div class="sting-role">composer</div>
    <div class="sting-role">audiovisual installations</div>
    <div class="sting-more">and many more yet to be explored.</div>
    <div class="sting-poem">
      different tellings of infinite perception,<br>
      spaces built with love and intention,<br>
      through questions that sting
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- PAGE 1 — ESSENCE -->
<section id="essence" class="sec sec-dark">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">01</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Essence</div>
      <div class="sh-s">welcome · who I am</div>
    </div>
    <div class="essence-grid reveal">
      <div class="essence-photos">
        <div class="main"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="surrealich — field recording" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="surrealich — field recording" /></div>
        <div><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="surrealich — tuning fork Mallorca" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="surrealich — tuning fork Mallorca" /></div>
        <div><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="surrealich — double exposure" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="surrealich — double exposure" /></div>
        <div style="grid-column:1/-1"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Collective Resonance — drawing by surrealich" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="Collective Resonance — drawing by surrealich" /></div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h2 class="bio-head">Welcome.<br><em>I'm Charlie, also Carlota, also surrealich.</em></h2>
        <p class="bio-p">I believe I am a bridge. Between the land that holds a story and the antennas open enough to receive it — not because they need to hear it, but because they are blessed to, because it is the moment of that story, the moment of that idea arriving. Between a community school in Tanzania and a feedback loop in a Berlin basement. Between the seen and the unseen, the heard and the felt, the technical and the ceremonial.</p>
        <p class="bio-p">Sound has been my primary language. And sound, like all language, can be perceived in infinite ways — through a cochlear implant, through a seismic microphone pressed against the earth, through thirty people on a studio floor becoming one organism as they surrender together to the source. Each project I take on requires something different from me. I don't work from a discipline. I work from a question. The project tells me what it needs. I show up with everything I have.</p>
        <div class="index-grid">
          <a href="#now" class="index-link">The Now</a>
          <a href="#tech" class="index-link">Technical Experience</a>
          <a href="#btl" class="index-link">Born to Learn</a>
          <a href="#ngoteya" class="index-link">Ngoteya Wild</a>
          <a href="#sensuous" class="index-link">Sensuous</a>
          <a href="#museum" class="index-link">Museum of Consciousness</a>
          <a href="#circulus" class="index-link">Circulus</a>
          <a href="#spiral" class="index-link">SPIRAL</a>
          <a href="#field" class="index-link">Field Recording</a>
          <a href="#productions" class="index-link">Productions</a>
          <a href="#dj" class="index-link">DJ Gigs</a>
          <a href="#contact" class="index-link">Contact</a>
        </div>
        <div class="facts">
          <div><div class="fact-l">Training</div><div class="fact-v">BA Hons Electronic Music Production and Performance · Catalyst University Berlin · 2021–2023</div></div>
          <div><div class="fact-l">Base</div><div class="fact-v">Madrid &amp; Kilifi, Kenya</div></div>
          <div><div class="fact-l">Languages</div><div class="fact-v">Spanish (native) · English (fluent) · Kiswahili (beginner)</div></div>
          <div><div class="fact-l">Tools</div><div class="fact-v">Ableton Live · VCV Rack · very low budget gear mastered to full potential · Procreate · Excel · budget management · volunteer coordination · monitoring and evaluation · donor reporting · Claude AI</div></div>
          <div><div class="fact-l">Licences</div><div class="fact-v">Driver's (B) · Moped (AM)</div></div>
          <div><div class="fact-l">Linktree</div><div class="fact-v"><a href="https://linktr.ee/surrealistch" target="_blank" style="color:var(--teal-light)">linktr.ee/surrealistch</a></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- PAGE 2 — THE NOW -->
<section id="now" class="sec sec-deep">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">02</div>
      <div class="sh-t">The Now · Intentions</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Kilifi · what emerges</div>
    </div>
    <div class="reveal">
      <div class="now-intro">I didn't plan Kilifi. I followed a word, trusted a pull, and went.</div>
      <p class="now-body">What I found was a hub already forming and already pulsating — artists, creators, builders breathing something at the intersection of the Indian Ocean, East African music cultures, eco-conscious living and grassroots energy. I have never felt something like that in my life, and on the day of today it is still pulling me. Deeply.</p>
      <p class="now-body">I want to be part of it. This space exists so that you can sense, however you can sense it, a little of where I'm coming from and what I could bring. I'm arriving as a visitor, open to what the coast has for me. If something here resonates — a collaboration, an opportunity, a project that needs what I carry — I would love to hear from you before I land. Remote work, sound design from afar, a conversation. I'm open to all of it.</p>
      <p class="now-body">Being a bridge is what I do. Bridging stories into the world through video, audio and the spaces between. Bridging people to places, events, routes, building budgets, contacting locations, planning trips, making things happen with what's available.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- Baobab Studios graphic design -->
    <div class="reveal" style="margin-top:2.5rem">
      <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:1rem">Recent work · Baobab Studios 002</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px;margin-bottom:1.5rem">
        <div><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Baobab Studios 002 — artwork by surrealich" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="Baobab Studios 002 — artwork by surrealich" /></div>
        <div><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Baobab Studios 002 — Utsai si Nyuwi EP" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="Baobab Studios 002 — Utsai si Nyuwi EP" /></div>
        <div><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="What seeds will we plant — drawing by surrealich" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="What seeds will we plant — drawing by surrealich" /></div>
        <div><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Le Bous Sacré residency Kilifi" style="width:100%;display:block;" data-lightbox="gallery" data-caption="Le Bous Sacré residency Kilifi" /></div>
      </div>
      <div class="now-reflection">
        As sensorial receptors, experimental weavers of story, illuminity lives in the unknown inbetweeness of it all… As the ancients breathe in the winds, carrying the elders' knowledge held in the water nested in the spores of the baobab bark… <em>una kusikia upepo ana imba</em> — As the antennas receive and the weight of it incarnates your body, they find a space of being within your memory palace that pulsates the grid of silence, the mycelial currents of the unsound that costume, morph us into… To choose to transmute? To become conduits? Asante. Ancient knowledge incarnating new skins to travel through. <em>Una kusikia? Una hisi?</em> Spaces like Baobab Studios, giving story a body to flow through… Grateful, not only of being part of this visually but of believing and being part of spaces and collectives giving space for new ways to transmute ancient knowledge, honouring alternative ways of emitting vibration. Being part of this visual story planted depths in my own ways of being, story holder, teller, keeper… How the seeds we carry shape the world we are growing.
        <div style="margin-top:.8rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(78,196,196,.35)">Art: Surrealich / dejaquetepique · Baobab Studios 002 · Utsai si Nyuwi EP</div>

The Kisukuma ethnic group in Shinyanga · daily sound geographies from Tanzanian villages · audio recorded inside Egyptian pyramids · and more arriving. These will become monthly transmissions, field reports, poems from the land.</div>

    <div class="reveal" style="margin-bottom:2rem">
      <p style="font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem;font-style:italic;color:rgba(78,196,196,.6);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:1.2rem">Two years as general coordinator of a Montessori community school in Moshi. A school with a kindergarten, primary support programs, extracurricular activities, a kitchen feeding everyone daily, maintenance, infrastructure, a volunteering program and an education team. Multiple cycles, multiple sectors, all running at the same time.</p>
      <p style="font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ghost)">I arrived not knowing the systems, not always speaking the same language as the people I was working with. I learned. Fast. I made mistakes and fixed them. I built processes from scratch. And somewhere in all of that I learned to listen more deeply than I ever had before — to what a community actually needs, to what isn't being said, to what is right there if you slow down enough to receive it.</p>

<!-- NGOTEYA WILD -->
<section id="ngoteya" class="sec sec-dark">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">04</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Sentinels of Engaruka · Ngoteya Wild</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Sound score · Tanzania · releasing 21 June 2026</div>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card reveal">
      <div class="proj-label">Sound score · Composition · Compositionalist</div>
      <div class="proj-title">Sentinels of Engaruka</div>
      <div class="proj-period">Ngoteya Wild · Tanzania · 2025–2026</div>
      <p class="proj-body">Ngoteya Wild is a Tanzanian wildlife and conservation storytelling organisation. Sentinels of Engaruka is their short documentary following Maasai communities and the endangered giraffes they protect in the Engaruka Valley. I composed the full sound score.</p>
      <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.8rem">Every sound in this film comes from the land. Field recordings made on location in Tanzania. My friend Naomi, a Maasai singer whose voice became the emotional backbone of the film — manipulated into ambiences, woven into every scene. The giraffe has no characteristic sound. So I found it. A seismic microphone on a djembe, my friend Danny nailing the rhythm after hours of trying together, until we felt it. Every protagonist in the film given their own sonic world. Mix and mastering in 2.1 and 5.1 with Beneath the Baobabs Studios, Kilifi.</p>
      <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.8rem">I had two months. I was also running the school. I barely slept. Every locator placed by hand, every scene felt from the inside. When you come back to your creative self after a long time away, you come back with everything you didn't know you were collecting.</p>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:4px;margin-top:1.2rem">

<!-- SENSUOUS -->
<section id="sensuous" class="sec sec-deep">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">05</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Sensuous</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Event collective · Berlin · QS1 Studios · 2022–2023</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sensuous-intro-block reveal">
      Sensuous was born on my birthday. A rebirth. A first breath. It started as a seeded question — what happens when you build a space where the senses are explored, lost and found. Through somatic exercises, collaboration with incredible artists, wizards, thinkers. Each offering embedded in so much love of detail — foraging, designing the space, building altars, investing energy and time and intention so that what people walked into felt like it had been made specifically for the moment they arrived. Co-created with my beloved Storm Hartley. Eleven events across one year in Berlin at QS1 Studios, each one guided by the moon and its currents of knowledge. It didn't dissolve. It echoed. Its potency is still echoing. And the intention is to keep planting it — in whatever space opens, in whatever city calls.
      <div style="margin-top:.8rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5)">Roles: co-organizer · sound facilitator · DJ · concept creator and director · graphic designer · space holder · AV installations · foraging · altar building · event logistics</div>

<!-- MUSEUM OF CONSCIOUSNESS -->
<section id="museum" class="sec sec-dark">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">06</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Museum of Consciousness · Sensa</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Cairo · April 3 2025</div>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card reveal">
      <div class="proj-label">Sonic performance · Biogeometry Institute, Cairo</div>
      <div class="proj-title">Sensa</div>
      <div class="proj-period">April 3 2025 · Museum of Consciousness · Presented at Biogeometry Institute</div>
      <p class="proj-body">Seven artists attempted to alter the audience's state of consciousness through sound alone. I performed Sensa.</p>
      <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.8rem">Before this, our group had private access to the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Black Pyramid at Dashur, the Serapeum, the Osiris Shaft. I recorded audio inside chambers 3500 years old. Those recordings are still finding their purpose and their weight. My skin and my field of perception are not the same after that experience. Egypt was where I rebirthed into creation — this was the moment I came back to making.</p>
      <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.8rem">Sensa was built from Serengeti field recordings, layered vocals, binaural pulses and the theory of otoacoustic emissions — the third tone your own ear generates without asking your permission. Inspired by Maryanne Amacher, Samawimbi, Helmholtz. The ear as instrument. The listener as unconscious performer.</p>
      <div class="proj-quote">to hear is to be stung. to listen is to surrender.</div>

<!-- CIRCULUS -->
<section id="circulus" class="sec sec-deep">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">07</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Circulus</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Live performance · Berlin · 2022–2023</div>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card reveal">
      <div class="proj-label">Live performance · psychoacoustics · feedback loops</div>
      <div class="proj-title">Circulus</div>
      <div class="proj-period">4 performances · Berlin 2022–2023</div>
      <p class="proj-body">Circulus was my shadow given a stage. A made-up creature representing the unpredictable, chaotic and unknown systems of the unconscious. The infinite layers and costumes of my persona — the masks that compensate, that project outward, that fill the space between who you are and who the world expects. Something I had felt since childhood. Something I finally stopped hiding and started performing.</p>
      <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.8rem">Four live performances in Berlin 2022–23. Loophole. Madame Claude. Ora collective. Autobahn — a club commission. Feedback loops, no-input mixing, psychoacoustics, DIY hydrophones in jars of water placed on speakers. Frequencies travelling through water travelling through the room. The ear creating its own tones without permission. A tea talk with the shadow, in public. A purge. A meeting. A necessary thing.</p>
      <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.8rem">Built on research into distortion product otoacoustic emissions and the activation of the third voice. Influenced by Maryanne Amacher, Alvin Lucier, Knut Auffermann.</p>

<!-- SPIRAL -->
<section id="spiral" class="sec sec-dark">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">08</div>
      <div class="sh-t">SPIRAL</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Audiovisual installation · Liebig12, Berlin · 2022</div>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card reveal">
      <div class="proj-label">First exhibition · 4-speaker installation · sound design</div>
      <div class="proj-title">¿Y cómo escuchará el mundo mi madre?</div>
      <div class="proj-period">Liebig12, Berlin · 2022 · surrealich &amp; Critical P</div>
      <div class="proj-quote">How does my mother listen to the world?</div>
      <p class="proj-body">My first exhibition. A four-speaker audiovisual installation — an experimental simulation of cochlear implant perception. What does the world sound like when you hear it through an implant? When you take the implant off, there is silence. When you put it back, there is a vocoder. It is quite poetic. It is quite something.</p>
      <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.8rem">My mother Alma contributed her voice and her experience. Julia Hann von Weyhern, a cochlear implant user, co-developed the project with us. My aunt Nuria Ruiz de Alegría sent watercolour paintings from Madrid — she dove into creating them through the story I was telling her. Morgan Edgerton performed piano, drums and voice for the sound composition. The sound composition was designed to travel through four speakers in the room, moving spatially, simulating what passes through the cochlear implant and what doesn't. The audience could listen with someone else's ears. There is no single way to hear the world. This was an attempt to make that real.</p>

<!-- FIELD RECORDING -->
<section id="field" class="sec sec-deep">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">09</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Field Recording</div>
      <div class="sh-s">my expansion of ears</div>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-card reveal">
      <p class="proj-body" style="font-style:italic;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.05rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.6);margin-bottom:1rem">My expansion of ears.</p>
      <p class="proj-body">I go with intention. I ask before I record. I give the recorder to the people I'm with so they can hear what I'm hearing — so they know this is a conversation, not an extraction. I have been doing this since Berlin. Forests, studios, streets, villages, wild spaces, ancient chambers. I have recorded in Mallorca, Berlin, Switzerland, Tanzania, Kenya, Egypt. Every recording is a document of a moment that cannot be repeated. A time traveller's tool.</p>
      <div style="margin-top:1.5rem">
        <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:.8rem">Recordings pending release</div>
        <p class="proj-body">The Kisukuma ethnic group in Shinyanga — ritual ceremony, the cadete, the twins, the call and response of twenty men from the village. Daily sound geographies from Tanzanian villages. Audio recorded inside the Great Pyramid, the Osiris Shaft, the Serapeum. These are finding their form — as transmissions, as scores, as seeds. A space for sounds the world hasn't heard yet.</p>
      </div>
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:4px;margin-top:1.2rem">

<!-- LIGHTBOX -->
<div class="lb-overlay" id="lb">
  <button class="lb-close" onclick="lbClose()">×</button>
  <button class="lb-prev" onclick="lbNav(-1)">‹</button>
  <img class="lb-img" id="lb-img" src="" alt="" />
  <div class="lb-caption" id="lb-cap"></div>
  <div class="lb-counter" id="lb-count"></div>
  <button class="lb-next" onclick="lbNav(1)">›</button>
</div>

<script>
let lbImgs=[],lbIdx=0;
function lbBuild(){lbImgs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img[data-lightbox]')).map(e=>{return{src:e.src,cap:e.dataset.caption||e.alt||''}});}
function lbShow(){const lb=document.getElementById('lb'),it=lbImgs[lbIdx];if(!it)return;document.getElementById('lb-img').src=it.src;document.getElementById('lb-cap').textContent=it.cap;document.getElementById('lb-count').textContent=(lbIdx+1)+' / '+lbImgs.length;lb.classList.add('active');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';}
function lbClose(){document.getElementById('lb').classList.remove('active');document.body.style.overflow='';}
function lbNav(d){lbBuild();lbIdx=(lbIdx+d+lbImgs.length)%lbImgs.length;lbShow();}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!document.getElementById('lb').classList.contains('active'))return;if(e.key==='Escape')lbClose();if(e.key==='ArrowRight')lbNav(1);if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')lbNav(-1);});
document.getElementById('lb').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===document.getElementById('lb'))lbClose();});
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('img[data-lightbox]').forEach(img=>{img.style.cursor='zoom-in';img.addEventListener('click',()=>{lbBuild();lbIdx=lbImgs.findIndex(i=>i.src===img.src);lbShow();});});
  const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');obs.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.1});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
});
</script>
